## Member FDIC, What It Means and Why It’s Important


**“Member FDIC”~** You hear it at the end of radio and TV commercials. You might notice the logo displayed at your bank. What does it mean and why is it so important for your bank to mention if they are a Member FDIC institution?


Find out more in our latest podcast episode with Carlton Gregory, Compliance Officer & Legal Counsel at VNB, as he explains what Member FDIC means and why it matters where your money is saved.
